baseline_reference.hardware_note: Existing PRO 6000 full baseline; cross-hardware comparison only, no new AR run

hypothesis: Removing a lexical penalty preserves useful self-correction and contradiction reasoning, improving final-answer accuracy. Confidence is still an imperfect correctness proxy.
primary_metric: scored final-answer accuracy on exactly the same IDs; task accuracies, paired wins/losses, answer completion, and elapsed time
runtime_caveat: Fresh Ours control and candidate use matching GPU counts, batching maxima, seeds, budgets and scorer; dynamic execution paths can still differ. A single small pilot cannot establish a universal gain.
scope: development accuracy pilot, not canonical full-cohort submission
selection_note: Same label-independent diagnostic IDs reused as a development pilot; these 60 questions must not be treated as held-out confirmation of subsequent tuning
